plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Local TCP port for the Python daemon RES: Local TCP port for the Python daemon REST API (default: 55065).
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Backup polling frequency with Amazon ser: Backup polling frequency with Amazon servers (default: 300s). Most events are received in real-time via HTTP/2 push.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.This plugin is an independent community: This plugin is an independent community development and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.com, Inc. The software is provided "AS IS", without warranty of any kind.

plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Choose your country and click the button: Choose your country and click the button. Your email and password are entered directly on the Amazon page, never in Jeedom.

plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Connected to Amazon! Your devices are be: Connected to Amazon! Your devices are being discovered.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Blocks spoken announcements (Speak, Whis: Blocks spoken announcements (Speak, Whisper, Announcement, SSML) during the night schedule.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.If enabled, the Whisper command still sp: If enabled, the Whisper command still speaks softly during night hours.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Caps any Set Volume command above this v: Caps any Set Volume command above this value during night hours (0 = no limit).
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Automatically assigns newly discovered E: Automatically assigns newly discovered Echo devices to this Jeedom object.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Used when running Amazon routines or glo: Used when running Amazon routines or global actions without specifying a device.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Adds any missing default commands on all: Adds any missing default commands on all existing Alexa devices without deleting your scenarios.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Removes all Alexa devices from Jeedom an: Removes all Alexa devices from Jeedom and runs a clean discovery from Amazon.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Clears saved Amazon cookies/tokens so yo: Clears saved Amazon cookies/tokens so you can sign in cleanly from scratch.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.This plugin runs on a lightweight Python: This plugin runs on a lightweight Python daemon (aiohttp + aioamazondevices) and does not require Node.js. If the daemon has dependency issues, use the "Relaunch" button in the Dependencies box above.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Are you sure you want to delete all Alex: Are you sure you want to delete all Alexa devices and rescan from Amazon?
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.All devices deleted and rescan completed: All devices deleted and rescan completed.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Are you sure you want to clear the saved: Are you sure you want to clear the saved Amazon session? You will need to sign in again.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Amazon session cleared. You can now sign: Amazon session cleared. You can now sign in again.
plugins/alexadevices/plugin_info/configu.Once synchronized, every Echo device get: Once synchronized, every Echo device gets these routines in its "Run Routine (List)" (routine_select) dropdown for Scenarios, Dashboard widgets, and testing. To trigger a Jeedom Scenario from Alexa by voice, use the device's "Last Voice Command" (last_command) as a Scenario trigger.

plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.What can you do with this Alexa device?: What can you do with this Alexa device?
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Quick guide to all available commands an: Quick guide to all available commands and automations. You can test or trigger any of them from the Commands tab or inside Jeedom Scenarios.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Reads any text aloud. Supports SSML tags: Reads any text aloud. Supports SSML tags for pauses, speed, or pitch.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Speaks softly in a whisper (can stay act: Speaks softly in a whisper (can stay active during night silence).
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Plays a chime and broadcasts an announce: Plays a chime and broadcasts an announcement.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Runs any phrase as if you said \"Alexa,: Runs any phrase as if you said "Alexa, ..." (e.g. "turn off lights").
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Controls media playback and updates the: Controls media playback and updates the current track/state.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Sets speaker volume (0–100). Respects th: Sets speaker volume (0–100). Respects the night volume cap if enabled.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Plays built-in Alexa sound effects (chim: Plays built-in Alexa sound effects (chimes, bell, doorbell, etc.).
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Starts music or TuneIn radio stations di: Starts music or TuneIn radio stations directly on the device.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Triggers any of your Amazon Alexa routin: Triggers any of your Amazon Alexa routines from a dropdown or scenario.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Blocks calls, drop-ins, and notification: Blocks calls, drop-ins, and notifications when you need quiet.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Schedules alarms or countdown timers aut: Schedules alarms or countdown timers automatically from Jeedom.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Automatically mutes spoken alerts during: Automatically mutes spoken alerts during configured sleeping hours.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Real-time availability and current volum: Real-time availability and current volume level.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Built-in room temperature (on supported: Built-in room temperature (on supported Echo models) and Bluetooth state.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Displays the latest voice interaction an: Displays the latest voice interaction and upcoming alarms/timers.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Forces an immediate state update from Am: Forces an immediate state update from Amazon servers.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.You can use SSML tags directly inside Sp: You can use SSML tags directly inside Speak (TTS) (they are auto-wrapped in <speak>...</speak> if omitted), or use the Whisper command directly:
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Maximum 10s (10000ms) per tag (Amazon SS: Maximum 10s (10000ms) per tag (Amazon SSML limit). To wait longer or repeat a phrase (e.g. 120s), use a Jeedom Scenario DANS / WAIT block.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Amazon limits each message to ~500 chara: Amazon limits each message to ~500 characters (~240s audio). Blocked during Night Silence if enabled (except Whisper if allowed).
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Accepts 0–100; automatically capped to t: Accepts 0–100; automatically capped to the Night Max Volume during night hours when configured.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Multi-room groups (WHA) and some third-p: Multi-room groups (WHA) and some third-party TVs do not support Speak or Whisper (Amazon restriction).
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Select any command from the list to see: Select any command from the list to see what it does and test it directly on this device.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Select the command \"Run Routine (List)\: Select the command "Run Routine (List)" (routine_select) and pick any synced routine from the dropdown without typing its name.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Mark \"Run Routine (List)\" as Visible t: Mark "Run Routine (List)" as Visible to get the routine dropdown right on the Dashboard widget, or test it above.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Create a short routine in the Alexa app: Create a short routine in the Alexa app (e.g. "Alexa, cinema mode") and use this device's "Last Voice Command" (last_command) as a triggered Scenario event.
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Amazon does not push internal routine co: Amazon does not push internal routine completions; expose a Jeedom virtual switch to Alexa or trigger on a monitored Echo state (e.g. dnd_status or volume).
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.Runs any phrase as if you said \"Alexa,: Runs any phrase as if you said "Alexa, ..." — ideal for Smart Home actions (e.g. "turn on living room light", "set thermostat to 22 degrees", "turn off workshop plug").
plugins/alexadevices/desktop/php/alexade.You can control third-party lights, plug: You can control third-party lights, plugs, blinds or thermostats via Voice Command (text_command) or Amazon Routines, but this plugin does not import them as Jeedom devices or read their state.
